name: QUADAS-2
license_note: Domain names and prompts are paraphrases. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: The first three domains are judged on both risk of bias and applicability; flow and timing is judged on risk of bias only. QUADAS-2 does not define a derived overall judgement.

domains.name: Patient selection
domains.short_prompt: Whether the patient sample was enrolled appropriately and matches the review's target population.

signalling.prompt: Was a consecutive or random sample of patients enrolled?
Did the study avoid inappropriate exclusions?
Were the included patients similar to the target population?

domains.name: Index test
domains.short_prompt: Whether the index test was interpreted without knowledge of the reference standard and matches the review question.

signalling.prompt: Were index test results interpreted without knowledge of the reference standard?
Was the threshold pre-specified when one was used?
Is the index test and its conduct similar to the target setting?

domains.name: Reference standard
domains.short_prompt: Whether the reference standard classifies the target condition correctly and was interpreted without knowledge of the index test.

signalling.prompt: Is the reference standard likely to classify the target condition correctly?
Were reference standard results interpreted without knowledge of index test results?
Is the reference standard and target condition similar to the review question?

domains.name: Flow and timing
domains.short_prompt: Whether the interval, reference standard, and analysis included all patients appropriately.

signalling.prompt: Was there an appropriate interval between index test and reference standard?
Did all patients receive the same reference standard?
Were all patients included in the analysis?
